changelog: **Report registry with a privacy floor** (#1903, part 1; docs/reports.md). Named report definitions (`src/lib/reports/definitions.ts`: key, typed columns, i18n keys, capability) loaded by one server registry (`src/lib/reports/registry.ts`) and served by `GET /api/admin/reports/[key]?format=json|csv|xlsx` — JSON behind `ADVANCED_ANALYTICS`, CSV/XLSX additionally behind `REPORT_EXPORT`, a report whose module the vertical lacks is a 404. Six reports: pipeline funnel, cohort comparison, source conversion, mentor workload, placement outcomes, weekly-report compliance; loaders reuse the screens' own routes in-process so no metric exists twice. Aggregate reports apply a minimum group size (default 5, never lowered): smaller groups merge into one labelled bucket whose count columns are summed, so totals reconcile, and whose averages/rates are blank; every response names the floor. New CI guard `npm run check:reports` (labels in EN/TR/DE, a loader per definition, a floor that can suppress). MARKETING overlay wording for the shared report labels. Covered by `scripts/test/report-privacy-floor.test.mjs` and `e2e/report-registry.spec.ts`.
